title: Twitch CEO Predicts GTA6 Online Mode Could Land Next Year
description: Rockstar remains tight-lipped on GTA6 online multiplayer, confirming only a single-player campaign at launch on November 19, but Twitch's CEO predicts it may arrive next year.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Online Multiplayer: Rockstar Stays Silent While Twitch CEO Weighs In

As the gaming community eagerly counts down to the launch of *Grand Theft Auto 6*, one major question continues to dominate discussions: what about the multiplayer? Rockstar Games has remained remarkably tight-lipped regarding the game's multiplayer component, which is widely expected to be the potential successor to the massively popular *Grand Theft Auto Online* from *GTA 5*. So far, the developer has not even officially confirmed whether such a mode will launch.

According to currently available information, when *Grand Theft Auto 6* arrives on **November 19**, it will launch exclusively with its single-player campaign. Beyond that initial release window, the studio has kept all details about future online experiences under wraps.

### Industry Predictions and Speculation

Despite the strict silence from Rockstar, external industry figures are already sharing their expectations. According to a report by Eurogamer, Twitch's Chief Executive Officer has publicly stated their belief that the *GTA 6* online multiplayer mode will likely land next year.

While this is by no means an official confirmation from Rockstar Games—given the developer's historical penchant for controlling its own messaging—the prediction comes from a prominent industry leader who understands the massive streaming and community potential of the franchise. Analysts and fans note that given the immense, ongoing financial success of the *GTA 5* online ecosystem, the introduction of a successor is practically an industry inevitability, even if the exact timeline remains unverified by the publisher.

### What This Means for Fans

For players looking forward to the next generation of open-world crime sprees, the confirmation of a single-player focus at launch means the initial experience will center heavily on the narrative and standalone world-building. At the same time, the prospect of an online mode arriving next year, as suggested by the Twitch CEO's remarks, offers hope that the full multiplayer ecosystem will follow a well-planned rollout rather than dropping on day one.

Until Rockstar Games decides to issue an official statement regarding the timeline or existence of a multiplayer successor, players should view predictions like these as informed speculation rather than confirmed fact.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar's cautious approach to the *GTA 6* multiplayer rollout makes strategic sense. Focusing the initial November 19 launch entirely on the single-player campaign allows players to fully absorb the new world without server congestion distractions. While the Twitch CEO's prediction of a next-year arrival is promising, we will ultimately have to wait for official word from Rockstar to know when the true successor to *GTA Online* will officially open its doors.
